story.title: Story Behind the Song
story.body: “Nightlight” was written on a sleepless train ride home. It is about holding on to the warmth of someone who is no longer there, those small reminders that still guide you in the dark.

lines.text: The city hums while I’m wide awake
You left a note, the kind that stays
I fold it small, then forget to place
Maybe time will sand the edges down
But some shapes never leave the ground
You’re my nightlight, you don’t fade
When the room goes quiet and the thoughts get loud
You’re the soft glow I can’t replace
Even when I know I should
I water ghosts, they grow on cue
Petals made of all the things we didn’t do
I talk to walls, they talk back too
Say it’s normal, I don’t think it’s true

note-that-stays.lyric: You left a note, the kind that stays
note-that-stays.body: This line reflects on the lasting impact of someone’s parting words. Even though the person is gone, the note and what it represents linger. It is a reminder of comfort, love, and unfinished conversations.
